P01.rationale: No founder or person portrait is used as a dominant human anchor; the left column contains only a QR code and a pull-quote block.

P05.rationale: The client portrait area shows only a QR code instead of a named person's face at meaningful size, leaving the expected portrait slot empty.

P07.rationale: There is no press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus visible on the page.

P10.rationale: A large opening quotation mark glyph appears in the pull-quote box, but it is modest in scale and the only decorative typographic element present.

P11.rationale: Three bold metric callout boxes (before/after style stats) are present but they function as typographic callouts rather than true data visualisations like charts or cost-math diagrams.

P12.rationale: The right column is well-filled with structured body copy across four labelled sections, but the left column is notably sparse with a large empty-feeling QR code block.

P13.rationale: The page is largely flat white with minimal texture; only a faint circular watermark element in the top-right corner provides any atmospheric quality.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used, so the criterion is largely not applicable; the dark metric banner has sufficient contrast for its text.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The QR code placeholder and absence of any real client photography make the page feel generic and non-specific to an actual business.

N08.rationale: The left column below the pull-quote has a large empty region with no content, creating noticeable dead whitespace in the lower half.

N10.rationale: No text is placed over a busy photo without a scrim; all text sits on clean white or solid-colour backgrounds.
